result: Explicit positive diagonal profiles have F in [2Dm,2Dm+1] and an actual m-dimensional delta lowspace on component1. Any common partition retaining all h components must have at least m members and true output rank at least hm. Taking h=m rules out a dimension-only C_D(h+F) bound for this observation class.
